cost.note: the chain holds one of the 20 jobs that the organisation's Free plan runs at once, for the whole window; runner time is free for a public repository

definitions.tick: the earliest started_at among the jobs of the run's first attempt that a runner took
definitions.window: [from, from + hours), from being the first tick
definitions.gaps_min: minutes between consecutive ticks in the window, plus the closing gap from the last tick in the window to the first tick at or after its end (or to its end when none came)
definitions.start_lag_s: seconds from the run's created_at to its tick, for the ticks in the window
definitions.slots: schedule only: the slot of a run is floor(created_at / interval); hit counts the expected slots, from the slot of the first tick's run, that hold a run, started or not; missed is a lower bound of the slots the cron lost
definitions.quantiles: the value at index floor(n * q) of the ascending list: the median is the upper middle value of an even count, the p90 is index floor(0.9 n)
definitions.verdict: PASS when the p90 gap is at most 15 min and the max gap at most 60 min, else FAIL; INCOMPLETE before the window has ended
